properties.name: Seattle
properties.description: Lake Washington, Lake Union and the Ship Canal, and central Puget Sound from Shilshole to Alki across to Bainbridge Island (Eagle Harbor, Rich Passage, Agate Passage, Blake Island).
properties.build: cargo run --release -p navigator_offline -- data/washington-latest.osm.pbf src/assets/graphs/seattle.bin.gz --bounds navigator_offline/regions/seattle.geojson --spacing 75 --sea-seed 47.63,-122.46 --waterway-types canal --waterway-buffer 40
properties.notes: 75m spacing keeps the gzipped graph ~2.6 MB; canals are buffered to 40m so the Montlake and Fremont cuts stay connected. The sea seed is open water between West Point and Bainbridge.
